hero.title: Build your club. Own every decision.
hero.subtitle: Striker is a free browser football manager - claim a team, set your tactics, work the transfer market, and simulate your way from the lower divisions to the title.

features.title: Everything a manager needs
features.subtitle: A full season-long game, running continuously in the background.

matchSimulation.title: Live match simulation
matchSimulation.description: Set your lineup and formation, then follow every match minute-by-minute as it plays out.

transfersLoans.title: Transfers & loans
transfersLoans.description: Buy, sell, scout, and negotiate direct offers - or loan players in and out between clubs.

leaguesCups.title: Leagues & cups
leaguesCups.description: Battle promotion and relegation across tiers, and chase silverware in knockout cup competitions.

clubFinances.title: Club finances
clubFinances.description: Balance wages against ticket revenue, sponsorship, and prize money - then reinvest in your stadium.

squadDevelopment.title: Squad development
squadDevelopment.description: Watch your academy prospects progress, and manage aging veterans as they approach retirement.

friendGroups.title: Friend groups
friendGroups.description: Create a private leaderboard with friends and see who builds the most valuable club.

claim.title: Claim a club
claim.description: Pick an unowned team from any league and take the reins.

manage.title: Manage every detail
manage.description: Set your lineup, work the transfer market, and grow your finances.

climb.title: Climb the table
climb.description: Win matches, earn promotion, and lift the cup.

login.title: Sign in to Striker
login.subtitle: Use your Google account to claim a club and start managing.

dashboard.renameError: Could not rename the team. Names must be 2-50 characters.

lineup.title: Lineup - {{teamName}}
lineup.saveError: Could not save the lineup. Check your selections.
lineup.incompleteWarning: Drag a player onto every empty slot before saving.
lineup.benchEmpty: Every squad player is on the pitch.

finances.title: Finances
finances.confirmExpand: Expand your stadium by 500 seats? The cost is deducted from your budget immediately.

transfers.confirmBuy: Buy {{name}} for {{price}}? This is deducted from your budget immediately.
transfers.confirmAcceptOffer: Accept {{team}}'s offer of {{amount}} for {{name}}? They'll leave your squad immediately.
transfers.title: Transfer market
transfers.windowClosed: The transfer window is closed - listing, buying, and accepting loans and offers are unavailable until it reopens.

offerLoan.title: Offer a player on loan
offerLoan.subtitle: Free, no fee - the player returns automatically once the duration elapses.
offerLoan.error: Could not list that player for loan.

transfers.noLoanListings: No players available on loan right now.

offers.intro: Make an offer on any player from their team page, or propose a different price on a market listing - listed or not, the seller can accept or reject it.

freeAgents.intro: Unowned players, free to sign - no fee, just their wage.
freeAgents.none: No free agents available right now.

coaching.intro: A head coach speeds up player development and raises your youth academy's prospect quality - no signing fee, just their wage.
coaching.confirmHire: Hire {{name}} as head coach on a wage of {{wage}}?
coaching.confirmFire: Fire {{name}}? They'll return to the open market.

cup.noCup: No cup found for your country yet.

friendlies.title: Friendlies
friendlies.subtitle: Challenge another team to a non-competitive match - it has no effect on your league position and pays no ticket revenue. The other team must agree to play, and there's a weekly limit set by the admin.

received.title: Challenges received
received.acceptError: Could not accept that challenge - you may be at your weekly limit.

topScorers.title: Top scorers
topScorers.noGoals: No goals scored yet this season.

team.confirmRelease: Release {{name}}? They'll leave your squad immediately and can't be brought back.
team.releaseError: Could not release that player - check your budget.

chart.title: Final league position by season
chart.ariaLabel: Line chart of final league position by season, lower is better

match.noNotableEvents: No notable events in this match.

headToHead.title: Head to head
headToHead.noMeetings: These teams haven't played each other yet.

groups.title: Friend groups
groups.subtitle: A leaderboard among you and your friends' teams, ranked by budget - not an isolated league, just bragging rights over the teams you already manage.

join.title: Join a group
join.error: Could not join - check the invite code.

groups.noGroups: You're not in any groups yet.
groups.confirmLeave: Leave "{{name}}"? You'll need a new invite code to rejoin.
groups.confirmDelete: Delete "{{name}}"? This removes the group for every member and can't be undone.

actions.title: Manual triggers
actions.confirmRunSimulation: Run the simulation pass now? This immediately simulates every due match for all users.
actions.confirmCheckSeasonAdvance: Check for season advance now? If the season is ready, this immediately rolls it over for every user.
actions.confirmPayWages: Pay this week's wages now? This immediately charges every team its player and trainer wage bill, the same as the weekly payroll run.
actions.confirmCloseWindow: Close the transfer window? Listing, buying, and accepting loans and offers become unavailable for every user until it reopens.
actions.confirmOpenWindow: Open the transfer window for every user?

setAiLevel.title: Set team AI level
setAiLevel.description: Only affects unowned teams - has no effect once a team has a real owner.

matchSchedule.title: Match schedule
matchSchedule.description: Sets which days and what time new league fixtures are dated on - e.g. Saturdays at 14:00, or every day at 16:00. Only affects fixtures generated after saving (the next season rollover); already-scheduled matches keep their date.

maxFriendlies.title: Friendly matches
maxFriendlies.description: Maximum friendly matches a team may accept per calendar week (Monday to Sunday). Set to 0 to turn friendlies off entirely.
maxFriendlies.error: Failed to update friendly match limit.

worldStructure.title: World structure
worldStructure.description: Tiers, groups per tier, and teams per league used the next time leagues are (re)created. Saving this alone doesn't change anything that already exists - use "Recreate all leagues now" below to apply it.
worldStructure.saveError: Failed to save world structure - check the tier, group and team-count limits.
worldStructure.confirmRecreate: Recreate every league and team using this structure? Every existing team, squad and match is rebuilt from scratch and everyone gets a brand new team - user accounts, admin access and the match schedule are kept. This can take a little while.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Countries the game can generate a world for. Adding one creates its leagues and teams right away, without touching any other country.
countries.confirmAdd: Add {{name}} as a new country? This creates its leagues and teams right away.

leagueSchedules.title: Per-league match schedule
leagueSchedules.description: Overrides the default schedule above for one league at a time - e.g. Spain's top division on Sunday afternoons, England's on Saturday mornings.
leagueSchedules.saveError: Failed to update that league's schedule.
leagueSchedules.resetError: Failed to reset that league's schedule.
